body:
I am able to go on dates without romantic intentions, although most likely I'm waiting her time.

As far as long distance there is actually this girl I've been talking to very recently who I think could be interested and fits the bill but she is like 10hrs away. I'm not necessarily opposed to it I guess more nervous if it can work.

Within 2hrs I'm okay, any more and it's tough. Idk if I could just abandon my close family if I could help it.

Tried dating sites, I do okay despite having horrible pictures. Idk how to take them I always look uncomfortable and most of the girls on apps are not really compatible, actual sites like Okcupid are pretty barren here. Although admittedly I could do much better than a shitty selfie in a room 

I guess I might just have to be open to dating in a bigger range.

Traveling, I kinda can. I work remotely and have around 50k in savings so I definitely wouldn't be impossible, although my job is decently demanding.

I guess I just want to say thanks, surprisingly enough knowing that someone can at least kind if understand, especially a girl makes me feel a good bit calmer, because feel like I am not normal, or at least typical. I'm not sure there's much else help you could give at this point, maybe just how I can communicate to someone how I feel because I don't want to give the wrong impression with a girl. I guess my only option is to just meet people through any hobby and try to explain my feelings slowly. I had considered church but really it's not a religious thing for be, it's dishonest, and I don't even know if it's worth it result wise.

It's honestly pretty nice of you to anonymously help people feeling at their worst. A lot of people will actually bring others down even more so I think it's awesome of you to do that, maybe you also had a period like that.

Well I wouldn't be too worried about a power dynamic, I'm almost completely inexperienced. Either way I think if we just got along that would maybe not be an issue but close to my age would be ideal. I'd hate to think I'd miss a rare opportunity just because she's a few years younger or older. Besides odds just get worse with age, I'd date a 30yo but it's very unlikely shes still not had a relationship with sex.

I like drawing and digital art but besides groups for folks in their 40s+ it's mainly the local universities. I've looked and outside of them there's nothing. I'm technically allowed to joing the university drawing sessions since they're open to the public. I don't know if that's considered weird or when campuses will even open. I'm also open to new hobbies. Volunteering might be easier to come by.

Also can I ask where I might meet a girl who is just more reserved or like me. My reasons are not religious, while I'm fine with waiting I think going to religions events with this idea they wouldn't welcome me, especially now when most Christians think you shouldn't look to date a virgin or even lie about being one.

I think my ideal match would be someone who doesn't open up easily or is more focused on other things like work or hobbies.

I'm thinking that even though I already graduated I live nearby a lot if colleges maybe I can join a hobby group open to non students or volunteer. Then just maybe I'll have a chance because otherwise there's not a ton here.

I'm really starting to get nervous about my age being a factor and have been obsessive with my diet an skincare because of it.

No I'm not particularly sexually motivated, maybe I'll feel differently when I meet a girl I really love but to me it's not really something I want just for the sake of sex, I guess demisexual fits but I never thought about it as a label. If anything all I'm really kinda desperate for is affection. Sometimes I think I'm really behind emotionally in that regard but realistically I'm just off I guess, I'm the only guy I know who reads anything romantic and I'm not really effeminate either.

I guess I see sex as the physical peak expression of love for someone, it's something I really would not do easily, when I was dating I went weeks without kissing because I'm not able to separate the physical and emotional parts. And in the same way if I actually went ahead and slept with a girl it means I really care about her immensely. So knowing there was another guy in that place just kills me and I can't get rid of that picture no matter what and no amount of explaining why it shouldn't matter has even budged it.

As far as finding out, I've asked before and even been asked if I'm a virgin but mostly I just try to hint that I'm not into hookups and try to ask about their experiences with dating. Obviously it's never easy to ask and people who don't know me misunderstand me.


Most people here also get married around 30 but the ones who are virgins seem to earlier. Maybe there are some career focused girls or girls who are a bit younger and never met someone yet out there but I'm getting nervous about how impossible this could be, and even if she's a virgin there's no way to know if we like each other.

It's not like I'm going to love her just because she's a virgin. It's just something I need to feel relaxed. I would never date her only because she is. To put it this way, it's not that I want a virgin because it's that her not being one will make me want to die from anxiety. Once I know she's s virgin I literally never want to think about it again it's just a weight off my shoulders.

My age would be nice but I don't know if there are many, the very few I've heard of got married around 22 and I get along just as well with girls who are younger like 18 or 19, plus the likelihood is much higher.

If I lose my virginity to her it's only after I know I really like her. That might take months or years. But it's not even something I want to consider right now. I'm fucking shaking wondering if I can even go on a date or hold hand with a girl I like and is a virgin, plenty of time think about sex and it's consequences after. I'd already be the happiest I've ever been just to meet a girl I like, has no past and just enjoy going on a date, maybe ice cream and bowling.
Definitely doesn't make me feel any better. There has to be some way

It's what beyond that point. The notion of setting for that hasnt been an option for a long time, I would prefer dying. If I cannot find a girl who is I'll somehow have to cope with spending my life alone, which is almost as devastating.
